{{Quote|Commander, we lost Gold Leader.|Gold Two during the Battle of Muunilinst|<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 10" />}}
A '''clone trooper pilot''' served in the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]] as leader of [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]]. He was killed by enemy [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|Nantex-class fighters]] forcing [[Gold Two (Muunilinst)|Gold Two]] to lead the squadron.<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 10" />

==Biography==
As the battle over [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] began a huge number of [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|Geonosian starfighters]] joined the battle, Gold Leader was killed while the rest of Gold Squadron was decimated. Afterward Gold Squadron was ordered to get out by [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 10" />
